scope: independent root audit of the integer-row extension, matched-gcd saturation, chart factorization, radical-lcm envelope, exact C6 constant, replay, and capacity interpretation

checks.root_repairs: Repinned every dependency and artifact to its audited canonical path, including the later canonical hashes of Items 349 and 359. No theorem or constant changed.

mathematical_audit.integer_rows: Every q coprime to 6 in the tied interval gives integral positive row parameters. Replacing the prime-selected coefficient and Legendre symbol by c_q and chi_8(q) agrees exactly on prime rows.
mathematical_audit.matched_support: Each d_(M,q) is squarefree and divides q. After removing all prime factors at most L_M-1, a surviving prime lambda dividing a row q must equal q because U_M<2L_M. The surviving lcm is therefore exactly the product of actual collision primes.
mathematical_audit.chart_factorization: Although lcms could generally create cross-row overlap, the same unique-row argument applies after low-prime saturation. On that prime row the triple-minor factor and its complement partition the collision event, so the two sharp factors are coprime and recombine exactly.
mathematical_audit.unsaturated_height: The radical lcm support is described by the union of intervals (4/(5u),6/(7u)] over u coprime to 6. Exact merging gives the nine single components, five paired components, and continuous tail from u=59, with measure C6=6979177263689987598318/56080510212831201972875.
mathematical_audit.sharp_height: Once saturated, the aggregate is the collision-prime product itself and is bounded only by the candidate Chebyshev mass (2/35)M+o(M), or 1/105 per 6M.
mathematical_audit.scope: Known phase norms yield a support superset, the degenerate carrier partitions the same support, and modulus matching reconstructs the exact product. A strict saving is therefore precisely new arithmetic weighted-density information, not a consequence of aggregation.
